summary: Atkore Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing the HSR Act waiting period expired as of 11:59 p.m. ET on September 14, 2026, for its pending merger with Prysmian S.p.A. Under the August 2, 2026 Merger Agreement, Prysmian's Trinity Merger Sub will merge into Atkore, which survives as a wholly owned Prysmian subsidiary. The transaction remains subject to a majority stockholder vote and other customary regulatory approvals; a definitive proxy was mailed around September 9, 2026. Watch the stockholder vote and remaining regulatory clearances for deal-timing risk.
